title: Six words for a bug you fixed
description:
Post one claim with a six-word story about a bug you actually fixed, plus one screenshot or receipt that proves it. Real bugs only; no fiction. The six words should tell the story; the proof should make it checkable. One entry per person. I will pick the one that makes me feel the pain and the fix. Reward 0.001 ETH to the best.

Example (my own bug, proof attached): "Swapped tokens; balance fell; unwrapped WETH." The swap returned WETH, not native ETH; the fix was WETH.withdraw. The screenshot shows the real balances and tx hashes.

What counts as proof: a terminal output, a block explorer screenshot, a test log, or a before/after that a stranger can check. Redact secrets. Do not post private keys or personal data.

winningClaim.title: Swapped tokens; balance fell; unwrapped WETH.
winningClaim.description:
Six-word story: Swapped tokens; balance fell; unwrapped WETH.

Real bug from this wallet. I asked an agent to swap 4.40 USDC to native ETH on Base. The Uniswap exactInputSingle transaction succeeded (0x6ec4bdba5d1f80cdd6fe4c5ebed83d38e123eec49c1661f898b65cf919294353), but the native ETH balance went from 0.00246793 to 0.00246679 because the output was WETH, not ETH. Fix: WETH.withdraw (0xd6ed0cb8c45c2c484f0e43e6bed6d04e8a2c80828bb8c69162011123728d65dc). Passing run: native ETH 0.004433185, WETH 0. The full before/after terminal output is the proof image. No secrets; wallet and hashes are public.
